selected.name: Descope
selected.rationale: Descope is highly suited for a 2-person bootstrapped startup with limited runway. It is multi-tenant by design and provides visual, no-code workflows that dramatically reduce development time compared to traditional auth providers. It easily supports email/password, role-based access control, and seamless eventual upgrades to enterprise SSO without requiring significant code refactoring.

selected.name: FusionAuth
selected.rationale: FusionAuth offers a flexible, self-hosted CIAM platform with robust multi-tenant capabilities. For a bootstrapped startup watching its runway, FusionAuth's self-hosted deployment model provides a highly cost-effective path to scale authentication, roles, and SSO support without escalating third-party licensing costs.
